Role Overview
Cognizant is seeking an experienced Knowledge Graph Data Engineer to build and operate the connectivity, profiling, and graph/search foundation that powers enterprise ontology and knowledge management platforms.
In this role, you will be responsible for transforming raw operational and master data sources into clean, lineage-tracked, governed, and queryable knowledge assets. You will design and support data connectivity, metadata management, graph platforms, ingestion frameworks, and search capabilities that enable scalable knowledge discovery and enterprise intelligence solutions.
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), data engineering, metadata management, graph technologies, data lineage, and scalable ingestion architectures.
Work Model
This position is fully remote within the United States , providing flexibility while collaborating with globally distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
Occasional travel may be required for client workshops, planning sessions, architecture reviews, and strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Data Connectivity & Integration
+ Design, develop, and maintain connectivity solutions for enterprise data sources.
+ Build adapters and integration frameworks supporting:
+ BigQuery
+ Cloud SQL
+ REST APIs
+ Apigee
+ Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
+ Pub/Sub
+ Establish scalable and reliable ingestion patterns for operational, transactional, and master data systems.
+ Support API-based integrations across enterprise applications and data platforms.
Data Profiling & Metadata Management
+ Profile enterprise data to assess:
+ Data Quality
+ Completeness
+ Statistical Patterns
+ Dependencies
+ Data Relationships
+ Source System Characteristics
+ Develop data discovery frameworks that support ontology and semantic model development.
+ Build metadata management processes supporting data governance, traceability, and analytics.
+ Surface data quality issues and metadata findings to architecture and business teams.
Knowledge Graph & Search Platform Engineering
+ Design and operate the enterprise Knowledge Core supporting graph-based data exploration and search.
+ Implement graph and knowledge management platforms utilizing:
+ Spanner Graph
+ Neo4j
+ Amazon Neptune
+ TigerGraph
+ RDF/SPARQL Technologies
+ Equivalent Graph Platforms
+ Support graph data modeling, relationship management, and semantic search capabilities.
+ Enable enterprise-scale graph analytics and knowledge discovery use cases.
Batch & Streaming Data Engineering
+ Build and maintain batch and real-time data pipelines that continuously synchronize source data with graph and catalog platforms.
+ Design ingestion architectures utilizing:
+ Dataflow
+ Apache Beam
+ Pub/Sub
+ Cloud Composer
+ Event-Driven Architectures
+ Ensure data pipelines remain scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient.
+ Support near real-time updates across ontology and knowledge graph environments.
Data Governance, Quality & Lineage
+ Implement automated data quality controls and validation frameworks.
+ Support schema discovery and metadata catalog capabilities.
+ Capture and maintain end-to-end data lineage from source systems through graph and ontology representations.
+ Establish governance controls including:
+ IAM Policies
+ Encryption Standards
+ Metadata Tracking
+ Lineage Instrumentation
+ Partner with architecture and governance teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards.
Ontology & AI Enablement
+ Support ontology mapping activities by providing:
+ Profiled Schemas
+ Data Dependency Maps
+ Sample Data Sets
+ Metadata Context
+ Deliver curated and well-profiled datasets supporting machine learning and entity-resolution initiatives.
+ Collaborate with Data Scientists and Applied AI teams to improve data quality and knowledge graph accuracy.
+ Enable graph-based AI use cases, entity matching, semantic search, and inference capabilities.
Monitoring, Reliability & Optimization
+ Monitor platform health, ingestion jobs, graph-processing workloads, and metadata services.
+ Troubleshoot data and pipeline issues and implement preventative solutions.
+ Optimize performance, scalability, and operational efficiency across the platform stack.
+ Manage cost optimization initiatives across cloud infrastructure and processing workloads.

+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
+ 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Platform Engineering.
+ Proven experience building large-scale ingestion, metadata, and data management solutions.
+ Strong expertise in:
+ Python
+ SQL

+ BigQuery
+ Dataflow
+ Pub/Sub
+ Cloud Composer
+ Cloud SQL

+ Data Quality Frameworks

+ Cypher

### Who we are

Gatik is in the business of autonomous freight, and that business is already on the road.

Every day, Gatik’s autonomous trucks move freight for Fortune 50 retailers, grocers and consumer brands across Texas, Arizona, Arkansas and Canada, connecting distribution centers and stores and keeping goods moving. At the heart of it all is the Gatik Driver™, our proprietary Level 4 autonomous driving system, powered by scalable, interpretable AI and engineered to deliver safe, reliable, high-frequency freight operations.

Gatik’s momentum is real. With more than $600 million in contracted revenue and $200 million raised in our August 2026 Series D round, Gatik has taken one of the toughest challenges in autonomous technology and turned it into a proven commercial business.

And the market is paying attention. In 2026, Gatik earned a place on Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers list, and the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. The Gatik Driver™ won an Edison Award for Advancements in Autonomous Driving, and Inc. named our Co-founder and Chief Engineer, Apeksha Kumavat, to its Female Founders 500 list.

There's a lot more road ahead, and some of the brightest, most driven minds in autonomous technology are building the next chapter at Gatik. We're taking on hard engineering problems, pushing the limits of what's possible and building on a commercial foundation that's already proven itself in the real world with some of the biggest companies in the world, like PepsiCo and Loblaw. If you're ambitious, love solving problems that matter and want to see your work make a real difference, you'll find plenty to get excited about here.

## **About the role**

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will own the data platform that turns raw fleet and simulation logs into training-ready, searchable, and versioned datasets. You will work closely with perception, prediction, planning, simulation, and safety teams to make data fast to find, easy to trust, and cheap to process at scale.

This role sits at the center of Gatik's data flywheel: logs from our trucks drive scenario mining, model training, closed-loop testing, and the safety evidence we need to expand driverless operations.

## **What you'll do**

* Design, build, and operate production-grade pipelines that ingest, decode, transform, and store multi-sensor logs from Gatik's autonomous truck fleet and simulation environments.
* Build internal tools and services for data labeling, curation, indexing, and cataloging, so engineers can find the right drives, events, and scenarios in minutes.
* Partner with ML researchers, autonomy engineers, and data scientists to design schemas and APIs that power model training, evaluation, and debugging.
* Develop and maintain feature stores, metadata systems, and dataset versioning for both structured data (events, metrics, vehicle signals) and unstructured data (camera, lidar, radar).
* Integrate synthetic and simulated data with real-world logs to support hybrid training, scenario replay, and simulation workflows.
* Build scenario-mining and event-tagging pipelines that surface rare and safety-relevant situations on our routes, such as unprotected turns, dock approaches, and adverse weather.
* Optimize pipelines for cost, latency, and traceability, with full lineage from raw log to trained model and evaluation result.
* Partner with simulation, cloud platform, and safety teams to automate closed-loop testing, regression analysis, and fleet performance analytics.
* Set data quality and observability standards, and mentor other engineers through design reviews and code reviews.

## **What you'll bring**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years building data-intensive software systems, ideally in autonomous driving, robotics, or large-scale ML environments.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, and working familiarity with C++.
* Hands-on experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines with modern frameworks such as Apache Spark, Flyte, Union, Ray, or Airflow.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures on AWS (S3, EC2, EKS, Glue, Athena) or Google Cloud equivalents.
* Familiarity with sensor data (camera, lidar, radar, GPS/IMU) and serialization formats such as Protobuf, ROS/ROS 2 bags, and MCAP.
* Deep understanding of data quality, observability, and lineage in high-volume systems.
* A track record of building reliable, performant infrastructure that supports both ad-hoc exploration and repeatable production workflows.

## **Nice to have**

* Experience in AD/ADAS, autonomous trucking, or robotics, especially with perception, prediction, or planning datasets.
* Familiarity with ML orchestration platforms such as Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Vertex AI.
* Experience with temporal and spatial data, including geospatial indexing (H3, S2, PostGIS), HD maps, and multi-sensor time-series alignment.
* Exposure to synthetic data generation, simulation logging, or scenario replay pipelines.
* Experience with lakehouse and table formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Parquet at petabyte scale.
* Familiarity with safety-critical development practices and data traceability for safety cases or regulatory requirements.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: CI/CD, testing, code review, and service deployment best practices.
* Experience working with cross-functional, distributed teams across research and production organizations.

**Salary Range:** $180,000 - $260,000

**More about Gatik**

Founded in 2017, Gatik has grown into a commercial force in autonomous freight, operating trucks daily in live customer networks across the United States and Canada. We're headquartered in Santa Clara, California, but our impact is felt on the roads and in the supply chains that keep essential goods moving for some of the biggest companies in North America.

Our trucks do some of the most demanding work in freight, running high-frequency, time-sensitive routes between distribution centers and stores, where reliability matters every single day. For our customers, that means more capacity, better service and products arriving where they need to be, when they need to be there.

Behind it all is AI-first technology built from the ground up for autonomous trucking, capable of navigating highways and surface streets and tackling the complexity of real-world logistics at scale.

ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE ONTOLOGY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Reduce the latency from something happening to Fluidstack knowing about it. Index operational systems, documents, conversations, and telemetry as they change, so a delayed shipment or a rack coming online becomes usable context while there is still time to act.

- Give every entity in Fluidstack's domain a shared identity. Connect a machine’s design, order, delivery, deployment, and incidents even when each system describes it differently.

- Turn what Fluidstack knows into business signals. Compare plans with observations across sites, supply chains, and compute operations, and surface the gaps that matter as the company builds at gigawatt scale.

- Build a secure platform where agents can be first-class citizens. Give agents access within each user’s permissions, with every answer traceable to its sources, freshness, and gaps in the evidence.

ROLE SCOPE

- Build the internal data platform that turns updates from procurement, construction, compute operations, documents, and conversations into fresh, queryable context for Fluidstack teams and agents.

- Make new sources straightforward to add, including vendor records, PDFs, spreadsheets, and exports, while keeping a clear path from structured data back to its original evidence.

- Ship query and retrieval services that enforce a caller’s permissions before data reaches an agent, including when an answer combines or summarizes information from multiple systems.

- Preserve source ownership, provenance, history, freshness, and access policies as data is transformed or combined, and propagate deletions and permission changes to downstream results.

- Set and operate freshness, quality, and security guarantees, using real operational questions and failures to judge whether the platform helps Fluidstack act sooner.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
